name: Redragon K673 Pro
description: A compact 75% wireless gasket keyboard with 81 keys and a dedicated volume knob. Features 5-layer noise dampening, tri-mode connectivity (USB-C, BT 3.0/5.0, 2.4GHz), and hot-swappable sockets for a versatile, satisfying typing experience.

name: Epomaker TH85
description: A feature-packed 75% wireless keyboard with QMK/VIA support and a glowing RGB frame. Tri-mode (BT5.0, 2.4GHz, USB-C), gasket mounted, hot-swappable, with 84 pre-lubed Creamy Jade linear switches and Cherry profile PBT keycaps.

name: Solakaka KI75
description: A premium aluminum 75% wireless keyboard with CNC-machined case and five-layer gasket structure. Includes a multifunction knob, magnetic wrist rest, side-printed PBT keycaps, and tri-mode connectivity (2.4GHz, BT5.0, USB-C).

name: SbocKeeb 75%
description: A budget-friendly 75% gasket-mounted keyboard with 82 keys, sound-absorbing pads, and a volume knob. Features hot-swappable sockets, full NKRO, vibrant RGB lighting, and customizable software. Comes with an extra supplementary keycap set.
